Name: Microraptor Dinosaur
Author: vampycritters
Description:
Changes the sprite of the Dinosaur farm animal (and optionally the Void Chicken) to look like one of 5 microraptor skins!

This mod is client-side; you can play with friends who don't have this and their game won't be affected. This goes for pretty much any sprite replacement mod.

(The information below is accurate to version 1.2.0 and up. If you're using an older version of the mod it's recommended to update to at least 1.2.0!)

IF YOU ARE NOT USING ADOPT N SKIN:
You can change settings like which microraptor skin you're using with the "config.json" (if you don't have one try running the game first, it should make one) (see table below for skins, you'll need to put the NAME, not the number, of the skin) or in-game using Generic Mod Config Menu if you have it! (It's recommended, but not required.)

Settings include:
Enabling/Disabling the entire mod's functionality
Whether Dinosaurs are changed
Whether Void Chickens (and Baby Void Chickens) are changed
What skin to use for Dinosaurs
What skin to use for Void Chickens (and babies)
Whether to use old skins (pre 1.2.0) instead of new skins (1.2.0+)

IF YOU ARE USING ADOPT N SKIN:
Just copy the "Dinosaur" folder from the "assets" folder of this mod into the "skins" folder in Adopt 'n' Skin's mod folder, and you're done!
If you want Void Chickens as well, copy the "Dinosaur" and "BabyDinosaur" folders and rename them "Void Chicken" and "BabyVoid Chicken" respectively.

The mod will automatically stop itself from making any changes to the game if it detects that Adopt 'n' Skin is installed, so it is now RECOMMENDED to keep the mod in your mods folder even if you're using Adopt 'n' Skin so SMAPI can let you know when there's an update available.
